name: ai-ecommerce-customer-support-chatbot
description: AI-Based Customer Support Chatbot for E-Commerce

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && python -m pip install -r python_ai_service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "PYTHON,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green" "npm run python:ai" "npm run server" "npm run client"
